And Hettie the Yeti has an idea for a groovy flower dance.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing makes Sula a picture with all her favourite things on it. It just needs one last jewel to be stuck on, but - oops - the glue spills all over the picture. Sparkles save the day.

programme.title: Yakka Dee!
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say ‘chair’, and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see a brown, a comfy and a high chair, as well as a pushchair. We meet a friend who has a wheelchair and sit at the beach in some deck chairs. The journey is repeated with some surprises along the way, and everyone has a boogie when Dee’s friend finally succeeds in saying today’s word.

programme.title: Lu & the Bally Bunch
programme.desc: The bugs get creative with new chalk until some of it runs out.

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: Kiri and Lou are invited to lunch with two very slow snails, Hemi and Lemi. Kiri is famished, but she tries to be polite and not gnash her teeth.

programme.title: Froglets
programme.desc: Ziff, Pipp and Button use kitchen foil to create and launch an out-of-this-world spaceship.

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: The Twirlywoos are in the hallway of a house, where they watch as a postman puts a letter through the letterbox. They decide to post the letter back through, and the confused postman posts it back again. After a bit of this back and forth, the postman rings on the doorbell and the Twirlywoos have to hide. As the postman hands the letter to the man who answers the door, the Twirlywoos run through their legs and hide in a pile of leaves. As the postman departs, they get the idea to post the leaves through the letterbox. They get carried away, posting so many leaves through the letterbox that when the family returns they find their whole hallway filled with leaves! The Twirlywoos return to the boat to discover the Twirlywoo Screen. A rectangle draws on the screen and when Great BigHoo touches it a handle draws on, and it becomes a door which opens and closes. Great BigHoo finds that he can open and close the door, but he gets carried away and manages to pull the door right off the wall! The Twirlywoos take turns to go through the door, until it's Great BigHoo's turn and he gets stuck. The other Twirlywoos join forces to push him through, and they all land in a heap on the other side.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Ben meets friends Thomas and Theodore to do some baking in the kitchen. Mr Tumble is busy getting ready for a celebration, but he has forgotten something important. There is a tea party in this spotty surprise. Featuring signs for the words bowl, invitation and cake.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: The Teletubbies go 'this way, that way' on a Tubby Car journey to the Hidey Hup. The Tubby Spinny goes 'this way, that way' too.

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: Giovanna and Baby Bear welcome babies Willow, Isobel, Lincoln, Ezra, Noah, Jason and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Inside everyone’s bags in this episode are Building Blocks which are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding safe, baby appropriate building blocks inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby! The fun rhyme ‘The grand old Duke of York’ features, as does a story involving Baby Bear. Plus, the Action Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with bubbles and the Goodbye Song.

programme.title: Tiny Tunes
programme.desc: Lisa and the children create sock dog puppets using old socks and craft materials, learn British Sign Language signs for man, dog and home, then sing and sign This Old Man.

programme.title: I Can Grow It
programme.desc: Aaron, Isla and Abbie embark on an exciting spring adventure around the garden, discovering the abundance of colours popping up in their inner-city oasis. But why does the garden become more colourful during spring? Our very own gardening guru, Chatterpot, provides answers to their horticultural questions.

programme.title: Monster Makes
programme.desc: Rebecca is keen to go on a travelling adventure and invites Murphi to come. Murphi’s time machine takes them to the dinosaur age, but when it stops working, they need to get making. Firstly, they create a paper plate dinosaur, followed by some colourful water blob creatures made by the Mini Monsters. Then, Rebecca gets a call on the Magic Monster Mirror from her aunt Antarctic, who makes herself some snow-building buddies to help rescue her snowman. The Recycling Express brings some paper straws to the attic, which Murphi and Rebecca use to make a straw sailboat.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Ginger and the baby Pea-Rexes discover a new game - Pea-Rex Pinball!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bingo loves horsing around with Dad, but sometimes he forgets Bingo is smaller than her sister. Mum teaches Bingo how to use her big girl bark to keep their fun within her limits.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels are having a picnic and notice that the chickens eat differently than they do. Duggee has his eating badge and can explain all the different ways animals eat. Some animals eat slowly like cows, who eat all day long. But others eat quickly like frogs. Some, like goats, are always eating, while tortoises can go a whole year without food. Some animals eat food that is very high up, like giraffes, and some eat food that is very low down, like moles. The Squirrels finish off their picnic, having learned a lot about all the different ways of eating.

programme.title: Let's Go for a Walk
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers go on a walk to a great place to play with pinwheels in the wind. On the way, they spot a bright red fire engine, play at being neighbours in some tiny houses, have a fun game on a stony beach and even explore a drippy tunnel!

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Audrey and her family visit a farm. They meet some of the animals up close, and Audrey feeds the guinea pigs with a carrot treat before enjoying cuddles with a baby goat. Then it’s off for a tractor ride, where Audrey meets a horse with a moustache!

programme.title: My World Kitchen
programme.desc: Jake is making traditional Australian meat pies using a recipe that his dad has shown him. Jake makes two sets of different sized pastry circles and fills them with a mixture made from lamb mince. One of Jake’s ingredients is black pepper, but his friends are not too sure about the taste when they try it before the meal. Let’s hope they enjoy it in the cooked pies! A kangaroo on the table is not the only special Australian surprise Jake has for his friends – he has invited Chris to play a traditional Australian didgeridoo for them!

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: Maddie finds out how really tall buildings are made out of steel and concrete. She visits a skyscraper construction site to explain how the concrete columns that are buried deep into the ground help to make it strong and stable. Then Maddie uses a special 360 camera to see all around her from the top floor. Next Maddie is finding out how birds fly. She visits a bird sanctuary and uses a special slow-motion camera to help us understand how Ollie the barn owl uses his streamlined body and powerful wings to take off, fly, and land.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Kika and her family are on a day out to the Woofton Transport Museum. But when their new audio guide starts malfunctioning, Kika needs her supersight to race back through the museum.

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: Aneeshwar and Lizzie head to a safari park to meet a herd of zebras. They reveal that a zebra’s stripes are unique to each individual. Not one zebra looks the same. Next, Aneeshwar and Lizzie encounter some red-bellied piranhas. These fish have huge teeth, and they see a large shoal of piranhas right in front of them being fed their breakfast. Finally, Aneeshwar and Lizzie discover what the wild connection is between these two incredible animals.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: It's early in the morning after the Brooklyn-Bells have returned from holiday and there's someone banging on their front door. It's Mrs Hobbs and she's furious. Waffle left Mrs Hobbs's kitchen taps running and now her home is flooded and there's water pouring out of her front door! But Jess and Simon will be Mrs Hobbs's 'knights in shining armour' - Sir Jess and Sir Simon Brooklyn-Bells to the rescue!

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Oona is a brave, clever puffin – just like her mama!

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: TapTap’s sister, TipTop, comes for a visit and amazes Yukee with her drumming skills. She is deaf, and she drums just as well as TapTap, making Yukee wonder how she does it. With TipTop’s help, Yukee learns how to feel the music.

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: Maddie and Triggs can’t wait to watch the season finale of their favourite show, Trumpet Cat. But there’s one small problem… snack attacks! Maddie’s popcorn is loud, Triggs’s doggy biccies are even louder - and no-one can hear Trumpet Cat! As Maddie and Triggs grumble about how annoying and different the other one is, they also wonder if these differences might also be what makes them the perfect pair.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: As Roly makes his usual noise in the Clubhouse, Duggee and the Squirrels reminisce about how completely different Roly was when he first arrived. Hiding behind his dad, Roly wasn't loud at all but impossibly quiet! As Duggee shows Roly around the Clubhouse, he squeals, hides and hangs off his dad, and just seems altogether too shy to fit in. Duggee has a great idea to introduce Roly to Norrie, thinking a friend will help him to settle in. But Roly is still too shy, so Duggee and Norrie start doing things with him, knowing this will help him to embrace the fun of the Clubhouse. While painting, playing with balloons and yelling, Roly begins to truly find his voice and be himself! Soon, Roly hardly noticed if his dad was around at all.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: The Numberblocks present their very own, very numbery version of the classic tale The Three Little Pigs and the Big Bad Square. Learn about adding ones and simple counting with the number friends.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: Ben the Pen writes the words of a song that Alphablock I sings. Ben is disgruntled because Alphablock I ignores his contribution and makes the song about herself – I AM I, I AM FUN. He changes the words to make her look funny rather than cool – I AM RED, I AM A CAT. Alphablock I starts to enjoy this and encourages Ben’s silliness. By the end, she is singing I AM A PEN and BEN IS FAB.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin and his friends are at a racetrack, where they have lots of fun with different types of bicycles. Meanwhile, the Tumbles are getting ready for the Great Golden Egg Race.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Preschool series. It's time to wake up, but Tinky Winky isn't feeling well. Soon after, Tinky Winky feels better, but now Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po don't feel well.

programme.title: Ranger Hamza's Eco Quest
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers discover how butterflies and moths play an important role in the environment. They find out that they are fantastic pollinators who help to create habitats for other creatures to live. They learn how their poo can return nutrients to the soil and how butterflies and moths can be food for other animals too. On the way, they get up close to a dragonfly and turn into Rambler butterflies!

programme.title: Football Fantastics
programme.desc: It’s Sophie’s first day. She worries that she’s no good at football but feels like part of the team when she helps the others work together to create a fantastic new football kit.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: In this episode, CBeebies’ very own motorbike rider, Grace, shows off three amazing machines that are all very little! Grace uses a little pick up truck to take some hay to the horses, shows off a little plane that can only take one person and then goes for a ride on a mini motorbike!

programme.title: Dodge's Pup School
programme.desc: It's show and tell day, and it's Bertie's turn to share why he loves gardening with the class. The pups are keen to give it a go but haven't fully listened to how it should be done. When Bertie mentions digging, Dodge gets carried away. Together with the pups, they end up ruining the garden. Bertie gets cross and feels upset. Dodge and Bertie both realise their mistakes, apologise, and become friends again.

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc: Love Monster leads his friends on an adventure through the Fluffytown Forest to make it in time for movie night, but he forgets to bring the movie.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: Animated series. When Mr McGregor locks him in a cage with Sammy Whiskers, Peter must join forces with the rat to escape.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Happy has always loved the water - even though it makes a mess! But while swimming around in his paddling pool at the playhouse, Duggee reminds the Squirrels that there was a time when Happy feared water.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Vida helps Tidbit when his new pet plant, Planthony, isn’t very well.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Supertato’s dancing is too powerful and destructive, but when he has to face Evil Pea in a dance-off to save his trapped friends, he soon realises his moves can save the day.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: The ducklings find a jigsaw puzzle and can't wait to put it together. But the attic is such a mess that there's no room left to play! Luckily, Spicy has spotted a sorting robot in the Farm of the Future.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Preston left an egg sandwich out for too long, and now its explosive smell is stinking up the whole town. Mojo and Bo need to evacuate everyone in Swoppiton before the eggy 'stinkplosion'!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When Dad’s accused of ‘fluffing’ in Bluey’s face, Mum calls a meeting to settle the matter

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bingo must learn how to play by herself. Luckily, Dad has a problem that needs solving.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: Zog cures Fifi’s hiccups with a big dragon roar. But when patients are too scared to be treated by him, Zog must choose between being a scary dragon or a doctor.

programme.title: Balamory
programme.desc: PC Plum is determined to perform Great-Granny Plum’s song at the Balamory ceilidh all by himself, but he soon realises it isn’t easy being a one-man band.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle discovers he has a talent for painting Mrs Hobbs's cat, George, and decides to share his work with her as a way to get in her good books.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Rafi and Finn want to read their adventure book at the Bake A Wish Café, but there are too many distractions - even Dash can’t focus! Rafi makes a wish to freeze the café so they can read in peace. At first, it works, but frozen trams, floating crisps and silly surprises keep them busy. When the wish fades, Rafi helps Jake, and the café comes back to life with lots of giggles. Rafi decides the café is too noisy for reading, so she makes a cosy corner in her bedroom instead.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: A photo of Gran Gran and JoJo’s mummy when she was a little girl inspires them to take a walk and compare old photos of their neighbourhood to see how it has changed over time.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Sarah and her best friend Duck embark on simple but exciting adventures, exploring the world both near and far in their own wobbly and imaginative way. A fair is being held in the park, which means Sarah and Duck can't find their bench.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: It’s Small’s birthday. Tiny is planning to put on a special show for him, which involves using her scooter and calling on help from the froglets and the singing flowers. But her scooter has developed a squeak. She calls on Major to help her mend it, but when Small accidentally overhears them talking about a scooter, he thinks that must be what he is getting for his present and he’s very pleased. But what he ends up with is not quite what he expected - but much more exciting.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: MeMo and BaBa measure things that are bigger and smaller. A ladybird is much smaller than MeMo and BaBa. At Play Time, they choose a magnifier and use it to look at the ladybird. The ladybird looks much bigger! They show the magnifier to the Yummies and use it to look at their snack. The tiny pea looks enormous. On the Lullaby Lake, they don’t need anything to make Elewhale look bigger.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: In a magical forest, colourful characters have adventures and are read stories. Igglepiggle is taking a ride on the Ninky Nonk. Upsy Daisy gets on too, and she and Igglepiggle wave to each other from their different carriages. The Ninky Nonk travels around the garden and soon everybody is on board. The Tombliboos and Makka Pakka wave to Upsy Daisy and Igglepiggle. Even the teeny tiny Pontipines are waving to their neighbours the Wottingers. Everybody loves waving.

programme.title: CBeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: Tom Hardy tells the classic story of Zog and his flying doctor crew, by Julia Donaldson.

programme.title: This Is CBeebies
programme.desc: Programmes start at 6.00am.

programme.title: This Is CBeebies
programme.desc: Programmes start at 6.00am.

programme.title: Roots and Fruits
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it’s fitness guru Garlic with a set of fun exercises to make you stronger!

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing and Flop are making ginger bunny biscuits for Charlie and Coco. But when Charlie and Coco arrive, Charlie's done a mega poo, and in all the fuss cleaning him up, nobody hears the chickie timer ring to tell them that the biscuits are cooked.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Preschool series. The Teletubbies eat tubby custard and ride the Tubby Custard Ride around Home Dome. A child in Tummy Tales tries to make his baby sister laugh.

programme.title: Tee and Mo
programme.desc: Tee and Mo find that the garden isn't big enough for a game of Spinny Disc. The toy flies over the garden wall and wakes up Mr Og! Mo suggests they move the game to the park but, as she is preparing to go, the lure of throwing the Spinny Disc proves too strong for Tee to resist.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Evil Pea has trapped Supertato and replaced him with an evil robot lookalike called Robotato. She has programmed it to do mean things in order to destroy Supertato's reputation so that she can take over the supermarket. Luckily, Carrot senses something's amiss and eventually figures out what's happened. She frees Supertato just in time for him to stop Robotato from carrying out Pea's meanest command yet: splatting everyone with a giant cream pie!

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Pando is at Bing's house today and has an earworm called Bingly Bangly. Bing isn't impressed with this, declaring that he is Bing. When Pando can't resist saying the name, Bing knocks Pando's tower over and wants him to go home. But then Flop suggests they try a 'Thingly song' instead.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Mojo and Bo need to move a crashed meteor. But every time Mojo goes near the big rock, moving turns to grooving. How can you move a meteor if you can’t stop dancing?

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, Norrie explains why sneezes happen, we watch an episode of Hey Buggee, starring the little buglets, and it’s the big finale of Agony and Eggstacy!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels are out walking around in the rain with Duggee and notice a rainbow! But before they know it, it’s gone and the Squirrels are devastated. They decide to make their own rainbow and go off in search of all the colours from everything around them, including strawberries, carrots and bananas. Duggee shows the Squirrels what he has been working on too - a rainbow cake!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When Dad’s accused of ‘fluffing’ in Bluey’s face, Mum calls a meeting to settle the matter

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bingo must learn how to play by herself. Luckily, Dad has a problem that needs solving.

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: Glitch and his grimbots have a long race on a very long wall - the Great Wall of China!

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Peter makes a rash promise to appease an angry Tommy Brock, he and his friends find themselves worming for their lives!

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: Animated deep sea adventure series. Captain Barnacles and his intrepid band of explorers roam the oceans in search of adventure and fun. A poisonous sea krait lays her eggs in the garden pod, just as Captain Barnacles has to navigate the ship past a treacherous whirlpool.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Every time Numberblock Nine hiccups, he falls to pieces- until the others find an unexpected cure. Learn about splitting numbers into smaller numbers with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: M can't resist munching everything in sight until a giant toad appears. Suddenly he is not the biggest eater around! This episode introduces the '-oa-' digraph and the words toad, coat, coal, goal, goat, moat, loaf and toast.

programme.title: Nick Cope's Popcast
programme.desc: It’s getting dark. Nick and the Popcasters spend an exciting evening helping the toads to cross the road. Will they get them all safely back to their pond to be with their friends and family? Norman waits to find out.

programme.desc: Aneeshwar and Lizzie head to a safari park to meet a herd of zebras. They reveal that a zebra’s stripes are unique to each individual. Not one zebra looks the same. Next, Aneeshwar and Lizzie encounter some red-bellied piranhas. These fish have huge teeth, and they see a large shoal of piranhas right in front of them being fed their breakfast. Finally, Aneeshwar and Lizzie discover what the wild connection is between these two incredible animals.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: It's early in the morning after the Brooklyn-Bells have returned from holiday and there's someone banging on their front door. It's Mrs Hobbs and she's furious. Waffle left Mrs Hobbs's kitchen taps running and now her home is flooded and there's water pouring out of her front door! But Jess and Simon will be Mrs Hobbs's 'knights in shining armour' - Sir Jess and Sir Simon Brooklyn-Bells to the rescue!

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Oona is a brave, clever puffin – just like her mama!

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: TapTap’s sister, TipTop, comes for a visit and amazes Yukee with her drumming skills. She is deaf, and she drums just as well as TapTap, making Yukee wonder how she does it. With TipTop’s help, Yukee learns how to feel the music.

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: Maddie and Triggs can’t wait to watch the season finale of their favourite show, Trumpet Cat. But there’s one small problem… snack attacks! Maddie’s popcorn is loud, Triggs’s doggy biccies are even louder - and no-one can hear Trumpet Cat! As Maddie and Triggs grumble about how annoying and different the other one is, they also wonder if these differences might also be what makes them the perfect pair.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: As Roly makes his usual noise in the Clubhouse, Duggee and the Squirrels reminisce about how completely different Roly was when he first arrived. Hiding behind his dad, Roly wasn't loud at all but impossibly quiet! As Duggee shows Roly around the Clubhouse, he squeals, hides and hangs off his dad, and just seems altogether too shy to fit in. Duggee has a great idea to introduce Roly to Norrie, thinking a friend will help him to settle in. But Roly is still too shy, so Duggee and Norrie start doing things with him, knowing this will help him to embrace the fun of the Clubhouse. While painting, playing with balloons and yelling, Roly begins to truly find his voice and be himself! Soon, Roly hardly noticed if his dad was around at all.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: The Numberblocks present their very own, very numbery version of the classic tale The Three Little Pigs and the Big Bad Square. Learn about adding ones and simple counting with the number friends.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: Ben the Pen writes the words of a song that Alphablock I sings. Ben is disgruntled because Alphablock I ignores his contribution and makes the song about herself – I AM I, I AM FUN. He changes the words to make her look funny rather than cool – I AM RED, I AM A CAT. Alphablock I starts to enjoy this and encourages Ben’s silliness. By the end, she is singing I AM A PEN and BEN IS FAB.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin and his friends are at a racetrack, where they have lots of fun with different types of bicycles. Meanwhile, the Tumbles are getting ready for the Great Golden Egg Race.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Preschool series. It's time to wake up, but Tinky Winky isn't feeling well. Soon after, Tinky Winky feels better, but now Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po don't feel well.

programme.title: Ranger Hamza's Eco Quest
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers discover how butterflies and moths play an important role in the environment. They find out that they are fantastic pollinators who help to create habitats for other creatures to live. They learn how their poo can return nutrients to the soil and how butterflies and moths can be food for other animals too. On the way, they get up close to a dragonfly and turn into Rambler butterflies!

programme.title: Football Fantastics
programme.desc: It’s Sophie’s first day. She worries that she’s no good at football but feels like part of the team when she helps the others work together to create a fantastic new football kit.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: In this episode, CBeebies’ very own motorbike rider, Grace, shows off three amazing machines that are all very little! Grace uses a little pick up truck to take some hay to the horses, shows off a little plane that can only take one person and then goes for a ride on a mini motorbike!

programme.title: Dodge's Pup School
programme.desc: It's show and tell day, and it's Bertie's turn to share why he loves gardening with the class. The pups are keen to give it a go but haven't fully listened to how it should be done. When Bertie mentions digging, Dodge gets carried away. Together with the pups, they end up ruining the garden. Bertie gets cross and feels upset. Dodge and Bertie both realise their mistakes, apologise, and become friends again.

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc: Love Monster leads his friends on an adventure through the Fluffytown Forest to make it in time for movie night, but he forgets to bring the movie.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: Animated series. When Mr McGregor locks him in a cage with Sammy Whiskers, Peter must join forces with the rat to escape.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Happy has always loved the water - even though it makes a mess! But while swimming around in his paddling pool at the playhouse, Duggee reminds the Squirrels that there was a time when Happy feared water.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Vida helps Tidbit when his new pet plant, Planthony, isn’t very well.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Supertato’s dancing is too powerful and destructive, but when he has to face Evil Pea in a dance-off to save his trapped friends, he soon realises his moves can save the day.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: The ducklings find a jigsaw puzzle and can't wait to put it together. But the attic is such a mess that there's no room left to play! Luckily, Spicy has spotted a sorting robot in the Farm of the Future.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Preston left an egg sandwich out for too long, and now its explosive smell is stinking up the whole town. Mojo and Bo need to evacuate everyone in Swoppiton before the eggy 'stinkplosion'!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When Dad’s accused of ‘fluffing’ in Bluey’s face, Mum calls a meeting to settle the matter

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bingo must learn how to play by herself. Luckily, Dad has a problem that needs solving.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: Zog cures Fifi’s hiccups with a big dragon roar. But when patients are too scared to be treated by him, Zog must choose between being a scary dragon or a doctor.

programme.title: Balamory
programme.desc: PC Plum is determined to perform Great-Granny Plum’s song at the Balamory ceilidh all by himself, but he soon realises it isn’t easy being a one-man band.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle discovers he has a talent for painting Mrs Hobbs's cat, George, and decides to share his work with her as a way to get in her good books.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Rafi and Finn want to read their adventure book at the Bake A Wish Café, but there are too many distractions - even Dash can’t focus! Rafi makes a wish to freeze the café so they can read in peace. At first, it works, but frozen trams, floating crisps and silly surprises keep them busy. When the wish fades, Rafi helps Jake, and the café comes back to life with lots of giggles. Rafi decides the café is too noisy for reading, so she makes a cosy corner in her bedroom instead.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: A photo of Gran Gran and JoJo’s mummy when she was a little girl inspires them to take a walk and compare old photos of their neighbourhood to see how it has changed over time.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Sarah and her best friend Duck embark on simple but exciting adventures, exploring the world both near and far in their own wobbly and imaginative way. A fair is being held in the park, which means Sarah and Duck can't find their bench.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: It’s Small’s birthday. Tiny is planning to put on a special show for him, which involves using her scooter and calling on help from the froglets and the singing flowers. But her scooter has developed a squeak. She calls on Major to help her mend it, but when Small accidentally overhears them talking about a scooter, he thinks that must be what he is getting for his present and he’s very pleased. But what he ends up with is not quite what he expected - but much more exciting.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: MeMo and BaBa measure things that are bigger and smaller. A ladybird is much smaller than MeMo and BaBa. At Play Time, they choose a magnifier and use it to look at the ladybird. The ladybird looks much bigger! They show the magnifier to the Yummies and use it to look at their snack. The tiny pea looks enormous. On the Lullaby Lake, they don’t need anything to make Elewhale look bigger.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: In a magical forest, colourful characters have adventures and are read stories. Igglepiggle is taking a ride on the Ninky Nonk. Upsy Daisy gets on too, and she and Igglepiggle wave to each other from their different carriages. The Ninky Nonk travels around the garden and soon everybody is on board. The Tombliboos and Makka Pakka wave to Upsy Daisy and Igglepiggle. Even the teeny tiny Pontipines are waving to their neighbours the Wottingers. Everybody loves waving.

programme.title: CBeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: Tom Hardy tells the classic story of Zog and his flying doctor crew, by Julia Donaldson.

programme.title: How To Clean Up For Cash
programme.desc: Josie and the team are in Essex helping David, who wants rid of his girlfriend Amanda's bargain buys. David has a vintage candy floss business and Amanda runs a retro ice cream parlour, so they're a match made in sugar heaven - but Amanda is the Bear Grylls of the bargain hunt, and has filled their home office with all her finds. Underneath the mountain of clutter are desks, and as busy entrepreneurs David needs the office cleared pronto! Whether it's shoes, expensive handbags, collectable artwork or even Amanda's jewellery, David is adamant it all needs to be sold. Hidden in the clutter, David discovers his Dad's old reel to reel tape of The Beatles that he's never listened to - if it's an original unknown recording, Dan reveals they could be sitting on a life-changing amount of money! Completely unaware her items have been boxed up and valued, Amanda returns home to the shock of a lifetime. Will the newly-cleared office be enough to tempt her to take the cash?

programme.title: Believe Me
programme.desc: With the help of QC Phillippa Kaufmann, Sarah and Laila receive documents on their original cases. They discover that leads were botched, incorrect information given to them, and internal investigations have largely exonerated officers. They sue the Met police under the Human Rights Act. The case is explosive, with some police officers effectively admitting to pressure from above to close down or 'no crime' some sexual assault cases to improve detection rates, and the Met loses. Soon after, with no warning, it is announced that John Worboys, now seemingly God-fearing and penitent, is to be released on parole. Carrie, now Director of Communications at CCHQ, joins the women and spearheads a publicity campaign to force a judicial review - an unprecedented act. They are successful, and Worboys' parole is quashed. Sarah's case proves crucial to the decision, demonstrating that Worboys had not taken responsibility for all of his crimes. She has her day in court after all.

programme.title: The Family Next Door
programme.desc: Australian mystery drama. Detective Gillespie pays a visit to Isabelle as she has news about Pleasant Court but is also armed with the knowledge of an investigation into Isabelle - why is she still pursuing a case when she's on suspension? Meanwhile, Isabelle does her best to befriend Lulu, who seems to be struggling to manage her rambunctious daughter Elvis - when Lulu makes it clear that she does not want to be interviewed for her story, Isabelle turns her attention to Holly. Deploying some investigative charm, Isabelle uncovers a nasty backstory to Elvis's past that prompts her to visit the father at work unannounced and unwelcome - the visit has unwanted ramifications when Pete turns up on Lulu's doorstep demanding access to his daughter, and Isabelle learns that her prior misconduct is being referred to the police.

programme.title: The Family Next Door
programme.desc: Australian mystery drama. Jules and Isabelle reconnect as he wants answers - when she tells him she's in Pleasant Court pursuing a lead, he vents his frustrations as she is risking both their careers and, more importantly, damaging their relationship. Meanwhile, simmering tensions between Fran and Nigel begin to explode as Nigel is still refusing to seek treatment for his depression and stalling on both his thesis and parenting obligations - things come to a head when Rosie leaves the house unsupervised and has a near-miss accident involving Isabelle's car and her scooter. Isabelle uses some shrewd tactics to get a hold of confidential files from Fran, but the papers don't provide the answers she wants - she reluctantly agrees to return home with Jules, but their truce is short-lived. When Jules learns that Isabelle has used his work ID to access some confidential information, he leaves without her and she is left alone.

programme.title: How To Clean Up For Cash
programme.desc: Josie and the team are in Essex helping David, who wants rid of his girlfriend Amanda's bargain buys. David has a vintage candy floss business and Amanda runs a retro ice cream parlour, so they're a match made in sugar heaven - but Amanda is the Bear Grylls of the bargain hunt, and has filled their home office with all her finds. Underneath the mountain of clutter are desks, and as busy entrepreneurs David needs the office cleared pronto! Whether it's shoes, expensive handbags, collectable artwork or even Amanda's jewellery, David is adamant it all needs to be sold. Hidden in the clutter, David discovers his Dad's old reel to reel tape of The Beatles that he's never listened to - if it's an original unknown recording, Dan reveals they could be sitting on a life-changing amount of money! Completely unaware her items have been boxed up and valued, Amanda returns home to the shock of a lifetime. Will the newly-cleared office be enough to tempt her to take the cash?

programme.title: Believe Me
programme.desc: With the help of QC Phillippa Kaufmann, Sarah and Laila receive documents on their original cases. They discover that leads were botched, incorrect information given to them, and internal investigations have largely exonerated officers. They sue the Met police under the Human Rights Act. The case is explosive, with some police officers effectively admitting to pressure from above to close down or 'no crime' some sexual assault cases to improve detection rates, and the Met loses. Soon after, with no warning, it is announced that John Worboys, now seemingly God-fearing and penitent, is to be released on parole. Carrie, now Director of Communications at CCHQ, joins the women and spearheads a publicity campaign to force a judicial review - an unprecedented act. They are successful, and Worboys' parole is quashed. Sarah's case proves crucial to the decision, demonstrating that Worboys had not taken responsibility for all of his crimes. She has her day in court after all.

programme.title: The Family Next Door
programme.desc: Australian mystery drama. Detective Gillespie pays a visit to Isabelle as she has news about Pleasant Court but is also armed with the knowledge of an investigation into Isabelle - why is she still pursuing a case when she's on suspension? Meanwhile, Isabelle does her best to befriend Lulu, who seems to be struggling to manage her rambunctious daughter Elvis - when Lulu makes it clear that she does not want to be interviewed for her story, Isabelle turns her attention to Holly. Deploying some investigative charm, Isabelle uncovers a nasty backstory to Elvis's past that prompts her to visit the father at work unannounced and unwelcome - the visit has unwanted ramifications when Pete turns up on Lulu's doorstep demanding access to his daughter, and Isabelle learns that her prior misconduct is being referred to the police.

programme.title: The Family Next Door
programme.desc: Australian mystery drama. Jules and Isabelle reconnect as he wants answers - when she tells him she's in Pleasant Court pursuing a lead, he vents his frustrations as she is risking both their careers and, more importantly, damaging their relationship. Meanwhile, simmering tensions between Fran and Nigel begin to explode as Nigel is still refusing to seek treatment for his depression and stalling on both his thesis and parenting obligations - things come to a head when Rosie leaves the house unsupervised and has a near-miss accident involving Isabelle's car and her scooter. Isabelle uses some shrewd tactics to get a hold of confidential files from Fran, but the papers don't provide the answers she wants - she reluctantly agrees to return home with Jules, but their truce is short-lived. When Jules learns that Isabelle has used his work ID to access some confidential information, he leaves without her and she is left alone.

programme.title: How To Clean Up For Cash
programme.desc: Josie and the team are in Essex helping David, who wants rid of his girlfriend Amanda's bargain buys. David has a vintage candy floss business and Amanda runs a retro ice cream parlour, so they're a match made in sugar heaven - but Amanda is the Bear Grylls of the bargain hunt, and has filled their home office with all her finds. Underneath the mountain of clutter are desks, and as busy entrepreneurs David needs the office cleared pronto! Whether it's shoes, expensive handbags, collectable artwork or even Amanda's jewellery, David is adamant it all needs to be sold. Hidden in the clutter, David discovers his Dad's old reel to reel tape of The Beatles that he's never listened to - if it's an original unknown recording, Dan reveals they could be sitting on a life-changing amount of money! Completely unaware her items have been boxed up and valued, Amanda returns home to the shock of a lifetime. Will the newly-cleared office be enough to tempt her to take the cash?

programme.title: Believe Me
programme.desc: With the help of QC Phillippa Kaufmann, Sarah and Laila receive documents on their original cases. They discover that leads were botched, incorrect information given to them, and internal investigations have largely exonerated officers. They sue the Met police under the Human Rights Act. The case is explosive, with some police officers effectively admitting to pressure from above to close down or 'no crime' some sexual assault cases to improve detection rates, and the Met loses. Soon after, with no warning, it is announced that John Worboys, now seemingly God-fearing and penitent, is to be released on parole. Carrie, now Director of Communications at CCHQ, joins the women and spearheads a publicity campaign to force a judicial review - an unprecedented act. They are successful, and Worboys' parole is quashed. Sarah's case proves crucial to the decision, demonstrating that Worboys had not taken responsibility for all of his crimes. She has her day in court after all.

programme.title: The Family Next Door
programme.desc: Australian mystery drama. Detective Gillespie pays a visit to Isabelle as she has news about Pleasant Court but is also armed with the knowledge of an investigation into Isabelle - why is she still pursuing a case when she's on suspension? Meanwhile, Isabelle does her best to befriend Lulu, who seems to be struggling to manage her rambunctious daughter Elvis - when Lulu makes it clear that she does not want to be interviewed for her story, Isabelle turns her attention to Holly. Deploying some investigative charm, Isabelle uncovers a nasty backstory to Elvis's past that prompts her to visit the father at work unannounced and unwelcome - the visit has unwanted ramifications when Pete turns up on Lulu's doorstep demanding access to his daughter, and Isabelle learns that her prior misconduct is being referred to the police.

programme.title: The Family Next Door
programme.desc: Australian mystery drama. Jules and Isabelle reconnect as he wants answers - when she tells him she's in Pleasant Court pursuing a lead, he vents his frustrations as she is risking both their careers and, more importantly, damaging their relationship. Meanwhile, simmering tensions between Fran and Nigel begin to explode as Nigel is still refusing to seek treatment for his depression and stalling on both his thesis and parenting obligations - things come to a head when Rosie leaves the house unsupervised and has a near-miss accident involving Isabelle's car and her scooter. Isabelle uses some shrewd tactics to get a hold of confidential files from Fran, but the papers don't provide the answers she wants - she reluctantly agrees to return home with Jules, but their truce is short-lived. When Jules learns that Isabelle has used his work ID to access some confidential information, he leaves without her and she is left alone.

programme.desc: Josie and the team are in Essex helping David, who wants rid of his girlfriend Amanda's bargain buys. David has a vintage candy floss business and Amanda runs a retro ice cream parlour, so they're a match made in sugar heaven - but Amanda is the Bear Grylls of the bargain hunt, and has filled their home office with all her finds. Underneath the mountain of clutter are desks, and as busy entrepreneurs David needs the office cleared pronto! Whether it's shoes, expensive handbags, collectable artwork or even Amanda's jewellery, David is adamant it all needs to be sold. programme.title: Believe Me
programme.desc: With the help of QC Phillippa Kaufmann, Sarah and Laila receive documents on their original cases. They discover that leads were botched, incorrect information given to them, and internal investigations have largely exonerated officers. They sue the Met police under the Human Rights Act. The case is explosive, with some police officers effectively admitting to pressure from above to close down or 'no crime' some sexual assault cases to improve detection rates, and the Met loses. Soon after, with no warning, it is announced that John Worboys, now seemingly God-fearing and penitent, is to be released on parole. Carrie, now Director of Communications at CCHQ, joins the women and spearheads a publicity campaign to force a judicial review - an unprecedented act. They are successful, and Worboys' parole is quashed. Sarah's case proves crucial to the decision, demonstrating that Worboys had not taken responsibility for all of his crimes. She has her day in court after all.

programme.title: The Family Next Door
programme.desc: Australian mystery drama. Detective Gillespie pays a visit to Isabelle as she has news about Pleasant Court but is also armed with the knowledge of an investigation into Isabelle - why is she still pursuing a case when she's on suspension? Meanwhile, Isabelle does her best to befriend Lulu, who seems to be struggling to manage her rambunctious daughter Elvis - when Lulu makes it clear that she does not want to be interviewed for her story, Isabelle turns her attention to Holly. Deploying some investigative charm, Isabelle uncovers a nasty backstory to Elvis's past that prompts her to visit the father at work unannounced and unwelcome - the visit has unwanted ramifications when Pete turns up on Lulu's doorstep demanding access to his daughter, and Isabelle learns that her prior misconduct is being referred to the police.

programme.title: The Family Next Door
programme.desc: Australian mystery drama. Jules and Isabelle reconnect as he wants answers - when she tells him she's in Pleasant Court pursuing a lead, he vents his frustrations as she is risking both their careers and, more importantly, damaging their relationship. Meanwhile, simmering tensions between Fran and Nigel begin to explode as Nigel is still refusing to seek treatment for his depression and stalling on both his thesis and parenting obligations - things come to a head when Rosie leaves the house unsupervised and has a near-miss accident involving Isabelle's car and her scooter. Isabelle uses some shrewd tactics to get a hold of confidential files from Fran, but the papers don't provide the answers she wants - she reluctantly agrees to return home with Jules, but their truce is short-lived. When Jules learns that Isabelle has used his work ID to access some confidential information, he leaves without her and she is left alone.

programme.title: How To Clean Up For Cash
programme.desc: Josie and the team are in Essex helping David, who wants rid of his girlfriend Amanda's bargain buys. David has a vintage candy floss business and Amanda runs a retro ice cream parlour, so they're a match made in sugar heaven - but Amanda is the Bear Grylls of the bargain hunt, and has filled their home office with all her finds. Underneath the mountain of clutter are desks, and as busy entrepreneurs David needs the office cleared pronto! Whether it's shoes, expensive handbags, collectable artwork or even Amanda's jewellery, David is adamant it all needs to be sold. Hidden in the clutter, David discovers his Dad's old reel to reel tape of The Beatles that he's never listened to - if it's an original unknown recording, Dan reveals they could be sitting on a life-changing amount of money! Completely unaware her items have been boxed up and valued, Amanda returns home to the shock of a lifetime. Will the newly-cleared office be enough to tempt her to take the cash?

programme.title: Coronation Street
programme.desc: The contents of Summer's journal sparks concern, Ben finds Eva comforting a tearful Maggie, Roy's advice unnerves Sam, and Jodie tells a fib to give Daniel the push he needs.

programme.title: Believe Me
programme.desc: With the help of QC Phillippa Kaufmann, Sarah and Laila receive documents on their original cases. They discover that leads were botched, incorrect information given to them, and internal investigations have largely exonerated officers. They sue the Met police under the Human Rights Act. The case is explosive, with some police officers effectively admitting to pressure from above to close down or 'no crime' some sexual assault cases to improve detection rates, and the Met loses. Soon after, with no warning, it is announced that John Worboys, now seemingly God-fearing and penitent, is to be released on parole. Carrie, now Director of Communications at CCHQ, joins the women and spearheads a publicity campaign to force a judicial review - an unprecedented act. They are successful, and Worboys' parole is quashed. Sarah's case proves crucial to the decision, demonstrating that Worboys had not taken responsibility for all of his crimes. She has her day in court after all.

Underneath the mountain of clutter are desks, and as busy entrepreneurs David needs the office cleared pronto! Whether it's shoes, expensive handbags, collectable artwork or even Amanda's jewellery, David is adamant it all needs to be sold. Hidden in the clutter, David discovers his Dad's old reel to reel tape of The Beatles that he's never listened to - if it's an original unknown recording, Dan reveals they could be sitting on a life-changing amount of money! Completely unaware her items have been boxed up and valued, Amanda returns home to the shock of a lifetime. Will the newly-cleared office be enough to tempt her to take the cash?

programme.desc: Moira and Dawn are left worried things are getting out of hand. Todd gives Charity one week to get the money. Robert and Aaron speculate on who's starting the fires.

programme.desc: The contents of Summer's journal sparks concern, Ben finds Eva comforting a tearful Maggie, Roy's advice unnerves Sam, and Jodie tells a fib to give Daniel the push he needs.

programme.title: Believe Me
programme.desc: With the help of QC Phillippa Kaufmann, Sarah and Laila receive documents on their original cases. They discover that leads were botched, incorrect information given to them, and internal investigations have largely exonerated officers. They sue the Met police under the Human Rights Act. The case is explosive, with some police officers effectively admitting to pressure from above to close down or 'no crime' some sexual assault cases to improve detection rates, and the Met loses. Soon after, with no warning, it is announced that John Worboys, now seemingly God-fearing and penitent, is to be released on parole. Carrie, now Director of Communications at CCHQ, joins the women and spearheads a publicity campaign to force a judicial review - an unprecedented act. They are successful, and Worboys' parole is quashed. Sarah's case proves crucial to the decision, demonstrating that Worboys had not taken responsibility for all of his crimes. She has her day in court after all.

programme.title: The Family Next Door
programme.desc: Australian mystery drama. Jules and Isabelle reconnect as he wants answers - when she tells him she's in Pleasant Court pursuing a lead, he vents his frustrations as she is risking both their careers and, more importantly, damaging their relationship. Meanwhile, simmering tensions between Fran and Nigel begin to explode as Nigel is still refusing to seek treatment for his depression and stalling on both his thesis and parenting obligations - things come to a head when Rosie leaves the house unsupervised and has a near-miss accident involving Isabelle's car and her scooter. Isabelle uses some shrewd tactics to get a hold of confidential files from Fran, but the papers don't provide the answers she wants - she reluctantly agrees to return home with Jules, but their truce is short-lived. programme.title: How To Clean Up For Cash
programme.desc: Josie and the team are in Essex helping David, who wants rid of his girlfriend Amanda's bargain buys. David has a vintage candy floss business and Amanda runs a retro ice cream parlour, so they're a match made in sugar heaven - but Amanda is the Bear Grylls of the bargain hunt, and has filled their home office with all her finds. Underneath the mountain of clutter are desks, and as busy entrepreneurs David needs the office cleared pronto! Whether it's shoes, expensive handbags, collectable artwork or even Amanda's jewellery, David is adamant it all needs to be sold. Hidden in the clutter, David discovers his Dad's old reel to reel tape of The Beatles that he's never listened to - if it's an original unknown recording, Dan reveals they could be sitting on a life-changing amount of money! Completely unaware her items have been boxed up and valued, Amanda returns home to the shock of a lifetime. Will the newly-cleared office be enough to tempt her to take the cash?

programme.title: Believe Me
programme.desc: With the help of QC Phillippa Kaufmann, Sarah and Laila receive documents on their original cases. They discover that leads were botched, incorrect information given to them, and internal investigations have largely exonerated officers. They sue the Met police under the Human Rights Act. The case is explosive, with some police officers effectively admitting to pressure from above to close down or 'no crime' some sexual assault cases to improve detection rates, and the Met loses. Soon after, with no warning, it is announced that John Worboys, now seemingly God-fearing and penitent, is to be released on parole. Carrie, now Director of Communications at CCHQ, joins the women and spearheads a publicity campaign to force a judicial review - an unprecedented act. They are successful, and Worboys' parole is quashed. Sarah's case proves crucial to the decision, demonstrating that Worboys had not taken responsibility for all of his crimes. She has her day in court after all.

programme.title: The Family Next Door
programme.desc: Australian mystery drama. Detective Gillespie pays a visit to Isabelle as she has news about Pleasant Court but is also armed with the knowledge of an investigation into Isabelle - why is she still pursuing a case when she's on suspension? Meanwhile, Isabelle does her best to befriend Lulu, who seems to be struggling to manage her rambunctious daughter Elvis - when Lulu makes it clear that she does not want to be interviewed for her story, Isabelle turns her attention to Holly. Deploying some investigative charm, Isabelle uncovers a nasty backstory to Elvis's past that prompts her to visit the father at work unannounced and unwelcome - the visit has unwanted ramifications when Pete turns up on Lulu's doorstep demanding access to his daughter, and Isabelle learns that her prior misconduct is being referred to the police.

programme.title: The Family Next Door
programme.desc: Australian mystery drama. Jules and Isabelle reconnect as he wants answers - when she tells him she's in Pleasant Court pursuing a lead, he vents his frustrations as she is risking both their careers and, more importantly, damaging their relationship. Meanwhile, simmering tensions between Fran and Nigel begin to explode as Nigel is still refusing to seek treatment for his depression and stalling on both his thesis and parenting obligations - things come to a head when Rosie leaves the house unsupervised and has a near-miss accident involving Isabelle's car and her scooter. Isabelle uses some shrewd tactics to get a hold of confidential files from Fran, but the papers don't provide the answers she wants - she reluctantly agrees to return home with Jules, but their truce is short-lived. When Jules learns that Isabelle has used his work ID to access some confidential information, he leaves without her and she is left alone.

programme.title: Believe Me
programme.desc: With the help of QC Phillippa Kaufmann, Sarah and Laila receive documents on their original cases. They discover that leads were botched, incorrect information given to them, and internal investigations have largely exonerated officers. They sue the Met police under the Human Rights Act. The case is explosive, with some police officers effectively admitting to pressure from above to close down or 'no crime' some sexual assault cases to improve detection rates, and the Met loses. Soon after, with no warning, it is announced that John Worboys, now seemingly God-fearing and penitent, is to be released on parole. Carrie, now Director of Communications at CCHQ, joins the women and spearheads a publicity campaign to force a judicial review - an unprecedented act. They are successful, and Worboys' parole is quashed. Sarah's case proves crucial to the decision, demonstrating that Worboys had not taken responsibility for all of his crimes. She has her day in court after all.

programme.title: Dead Man's Evidence
programme.desc: 1963. Crime drama directed by Francis Searle and starring Conrad Phillips and Jane Griffiths. Phillips stars as a British secret agent investigating the discovery of a dead, washed up frogman. [S]

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: 1963. Enjoy a brilliant performance from bass player and singer Heinz with Dreams Do Come True.

programme.title: The Rogues
programme.desc: Money Is For Burning. 1965. Gig Young, David Niven and Charles Boyer are The Rogues, members of two related families of international forgers and conmen. [S]

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: The Vandals. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Victor Woolf & Rufus Cruickshank. Robin is blamed for a series of attacks and the Sheriff tries to capture him but where is the evidence? [S]

programme.title: The Buccaneers
programme.desc: Dangerous Cargo. 1957. Stars Robert Shaw, Sarah Lawson & Ivan Craig. Tempest is tasked with transferring a very important passenger to Barbados under the watchful eye of the Spanish. [S]

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: The Trap. 1959. Stars: Conrad Phillips, Willoughby Goddard & Jennifer Jayne. By using a traitor planted in Tell's camp, Gessler plans to smash the resistance movement in one swoop. [S]

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: Dr. Damon's Experiment. 1954. Stars Sandra Dorne & Laurence Naismith. An eminent psychiatrist returns home early from a conference to find his wife with another man, leading him to seek revenge. [S]

programme.title: Kill Her Gently
programme.desc: 1957. Thriller. Directed by Charles Saunders. Stars Griffith Jones, Maureen Connell & Marc Lawrence. Two convicts who escape prison are picked up by a motorist who helps them on the run. [S]

programme.title: In a Lonely Place
programme.desc: 1950. Drama. Directed by Nicholas Ray. Stars Humphrey Bogart & Gloria Grahame. When a screenwriter is accused of murder his neighbour comes to his rescue, but she soon starts to have her doubts. [S]

programme.title: Park Plaza 605
programme.desc: 1953. Crime drama directed by Bernard Knowles. A private detective solves a murder, which he was accused of. Starring Tom Conway, Eva Bartok and Sid James. [S]

programme.title: Four Star Playhouse
programme.desc: 1955. Drama. Directed by Roy Kellino. Stars Dick Powell, Jean Willes & Herb Vigran. Dante runs into an old flame who reveals that the party she's with want to rob the place, but can he stop them? [S]

programme.title: Sergeant Cork
programme.desc: The Case of the Public Paragon. 1963. Stars John Barrie, William Gaunt & John Richmond. An MP is killed in his living room. His wife and the maid see the killer fleeing through the front door... [S]

programme.title: Richard the Lionheart
programme.desc: King Arthur's Sword. 1962. Stars Dermot Walsh, Ferdy Mayne & Daphne Anderson. Richard refuses to believe that King Arthur's sword has been stolen and decides to visit the tomb where it is held. [S]

programme.title: Home to Danger
programme.desc: 1951. Crime. Director: Terence Fisher. Stars Alan Wheatley, Guy Rolfe & Stanley Baker. Barbara returns from abroad after her father ended his life. A changed will leaves Barbara in mortal danger. [S]

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: Get up and dance for some 60s rock and roll with That Old Yeah Yeah Feeling by Shane Fenton and The Fentones.

programme.title: Meet John Doe
programme.desc: 1941. Drama. Directed by Frank Capra. Stars Gary Cooper, Barbara Stanwyck & Edward Arnold. A drifter finds himself at the centre of a political movement after becoming part of a fraudulent story. [S]

programme.title: The Directors
programme.desc: Sam Peckinpah, a hard-hitting director who had seen atrocities at the end of the war as a marine became known for his violent scenes, he is remembered as the man who reinvented the western. [S]

programme.title: The Veil
programme.desc: Food on the Table. 1958. Stars Boris Karloff, Kay Stewart & Tudor Owen. A sea captain is trapped in a loveless marriage and plots to kill his wife to be with another woman. [S]

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: Vintage natural history short Mites & Monsters starts the show off, then we're off to 60s for a proper dance and there's some wonderful musical delights with rare Scopitones. [S]

programme.title: Francis Durbridge's...
programme.desc: ... Bat Out of Hell. 1966. Stars Sylvia Syms, John Thaw & Dudley Foster. The net tightens around the killer and a tragic event takes place between Mark and Diana. [S]

programme.title: Maigret
programme.desc: Maigret in Montmartre. 1991. Stars Bruno Cremer, Jacqueline Danno & Jean-Louis Foulquier. A stripper who reports a murder that has not happened, is later found dead. Can Maigret find the killer? [S]

programme.title: The Mummy
programme.desc: 1959. Horror. Directed by Terence Fisher. Stars Peter Cushing, Christopher Lee & Yvonne Furneaux. A mummified priest is awakened by the opening of an Egyptian princess's sarcophagus. [S]

programme.title: Border Incident
programme.desc: 1949. Thriller. Directed by Anthony Mann. Stars Ricardo Montalban, George Murphy & Howard Da Silva. Two agents go undercover to stop the smuggling of Mexican migrant workers into California. [S]

programme.title: How To Clean Up For Cash
programme.desc: Josie and the team are in Essex helping David, who wants rid of his girlfriend Amanda's bargain buys. David has a vintage candy floss business and Amanda runs a retro ice cream parlour, so they're a match made in sugar heaven - but Amanda is the Bear Grylls of the bargain hunt, and has filled their home office with all her finds. Underneath the mountain of clutter are desks, and as busy entrepreneurs David needs the office cleared pronto! Whether it's shoes, expensive handbags, collectable artwork or even Amanda's jewellery, David is adamant it all needs to be sold. Hidden in the clutter, David discovers his Dad's old reel to reel tape of The Beatles that he's never listened to - if it's an original unknown recording, Dan reveals they could be sitting on a life-changing amount of money! programme.title: Believe Me
programme.desc: With the help of QC Phillippa Kaufmann, Sarah and Laila receive documents on their original cases. They discover that leads were botched, incorrect information given to them, and internal investigations have largely exonerated officers. They sue the Met police under the Human Rights Act. The case is explosive, with some police officers effectively admitting to pressure from above to close down or 'no crime' some sexual assault cases to improve detection rates, and the Met loses. Soon after, with no warning, it is announced that John Worboys, now seemingly God-fearing and penitent, is to be released on parole. Carrie, now Director of Communications at CCHQ, joins the women and spearheads a publicity campaign to force a judicial review - an unprecedented act. They are successful, and Worboys' parole is quashed. Sarah's case proves crucial to the decision, demonstrating that Worboys had not taken responsibility for all of his crimes. She has her day in court after all.

programme.desc: Australian mystery drama. Detective Gillespie pays a visit to Isabelle as she has news about Pleasant Court but is also armed with the knowledge of an investigation into Isabelle - why is she still pursuing a case when she's on suspension? Meanwhile, Isabelle does her best to befriend Lulu, who seems to be struggling to manage her rambunctious daughter Elvis - when Lulu makes it clear that she does not want to be interviewed for her story, Isabelle turns her attention to Holly. Deploying some investigative charm, Isabelle uncovers a nasty backstory to Elvis's past that prompts her to visit the father at work unannounced and unwelcome - the visit has unwanted ramifications when Pete turns up on Lulu's doorstep demanding access to his daughter, and Isabelle learns that her prior misconduct is being referred to the police.

programme.title: The Family Next Door
programme.desc: Australian mystery drama. Jules and Isabelle reconnect as he wants answers - when she tells him she's in Pleasant Court pursuing a lead, he vents his frustrations as she is risking both their careers and, more importantly, damaging their relationship. Meanwhile, simmering tensions between Fran and Nigel begin to explode as Nigel is still refusing to seek treatment for his depression and stalling on both his thesis and parenting obligations - things come to a head when Rosie leaves the house unsupervised and has a near-miss accident involving Isabelle's car and her scooter. Isabelle uses some shrewd tactics to get a hold of confidential files from Fran, but the papers don't provide the answers she wants - she reluctantly agrees to return home with Jules, but their truce is short-lived. When Jules learns that Isabelle has used his work ID to access some confidential information, he leaves without her and she is left alone.
